result_text:
I changed the region ticket query so the overview lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It is the same `ORDER BY` the sales-rep list uses, and its Javadoc now says so.

`RegionManagerTest` passes offline. That test has only one open ticket in the region, so it does not exercise the new order. I did not add a test for the T-1…T-5 example from the task. The only caller of this query is `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so nothing else changes. Nothing is committed.
